research_question: Can PSW claim a mechanism-level advantage beyond established variational execution, persistent data structures, faceted/guarded values and incremental/self-adjusting computation?

sources.source: Christian Kästner / CMU research overview and OOPSLA 2018 publication page
sources.finding: Variational execution executes many configurations at once, tracks alternative concrete values, follows configuration-dependent branches, and explicitly tracks differences only where they matter while sharing similarities. The 2018 bytecode-transformation work reports aggressive execution redundancy sharing and substantial speedups over a prior variational interpreter.
sources.collision: VERY_HIGH with PSW shared alternative values + shared pure execution

sources.source: Austin, Yang, Flanagan, Solar-Lezama, Faceted Execution of Policy-Agnostic Programs, PLAS 2013 / author publication page
sources.finding: Faceted execution is established prior art for values whose visible result depends on a condition/policy context, closely colliding with guarded alternative values.

sources.source: Driscoll, Sarnak, Sleator, Tarjan, Making Data Structures Persistent, JCSS 1989 / Princeton
sources.finding: Persistent structures keep old and new versions accessible and provide systematic structural-sharing techniques; reported persistent search-tree constructions have logarithmic access/update and O(1) space per update in the stated setting.
sources.collision: HIGH with branch versions/path-copy state sharing

sources.source: Sarnak and Tarjan persistent search trees / Princeton technical report
sources.finding: Persistent search trees preserve past and present versions with O(log m) query/update and O(1) space per update for their specific structure.

sources.source: Acar self-adjusting computation thesis / CMU; Blelloch research overview
sources.finding: Self-adjusting computation tracks computation dependencies and propagates only changes required after inputs/decisions change; dependence tracking and change propagation directly collide with PSW causal/read-set-aware transition reuse.
sources.collision: HIGH with H5/H6 shared transition lifting and causal slicing

prior_art_effect: Broad PSW novelty collapses. Structural sharing, guarded values, many-world/configuration co-execution and change-propagation are established mechanisms. Any surviving claim must be a project-specific composition and measured representation envelope for Frank unresolved epistemic alternatives, not a new general computing paradigm.
known_risk: Existing variational execution work demonstrates that sharing can scale but also incurs significant runtime overhead; a Frank implementation cannot assume compression automatically produces end-to-end speedup.
